cards.caption: One person is dead and four others were hurt in a shooting at a gym in DC's Logan Circle, according to WJLA. Details are still emerging.
UNITED24 Media reports Ukraine has struck all five of Russia's largest oil refineries in less than two weeks. The campaign concerns the fuel that reaches Russian drivers and markets.
Microsoft has confirmed active exploitation of a new Outlook zero-day and patched nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities. Users should install updates as soon as they become available.
A Ukrainian drone reportedly struck a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland, according to the BBC. The report adds to a wider run of Baltic-area developments tied to the war.
Beau Rose Jessup, the daughter of British actress Lisa Maxwell, has died at 27 in New York City, according to reports. Tributes are being shared as her name trends.
Officials say eight people, including two children, died after a building collapse in New York City. The story is still developing as officials provide updates.
A report says Paramount could pause Superman for a decade if Henry Cavill turns down a return, while Cavill says playing the role was an honor.

Daily Gate City reports that an Israeli strike hit one of the main hospitals still operating in Gaza, killing 6 people. The story is one of several recent reports on the state of care in the territory.
Cardi B has shared the first photos of her son with Stefon Diggs as he turned one, including his uncommon name. A balloon-filled birthday party marked the milestone.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is expected to testify before Congress as lawmakers push for a crackdown on chip exports to China. Senator Jim Banks wants Commerce figure Howard Lutnick to testify as well.
The Pentagon has identified all six American troops killed in Kuwait during the ongoing Iran war. President Trump has also threatened to renew strikes against Iran.

Take-Two is reportedly strengthening its legal defenses against AI-built clones of GTA 6 as fans look for a PC release date. A former Rockstar tech director says the PC port could arrive sooner than expected.

Russia has put the number of foreign military deaths in its war on Ukraine at over 11,000, according to its own records as reported by The Japan Times. The figure comes from Russia and has not been independently confirmed in the headlines.

SpaceX is pushing for a double landing with its next Starship test flight, a feat the company's rocketry effort has never achieved. The attempt is one of the most-searched space stories in the US right now.
Officials say a woman who drove onto a Kansas soccer field, killing 2 people, will not face charges. The decision has been made public.
Taylor Swift is set to perform at the CMA Awards for the first time in 13 years, one of the most-searched entertainment stories in the US right now.
Iran says it targeted a US radar site in Bahrain, but CENTCOM denies that claim and says two drones were shot down. The US says it intercepted Iranian drone attacks.
Creighton legend Doug McDermott has retired after 12 NBA seasons with the Bulls, Knicks, Thunder, Spurs and more. His career spanned several teams across the league.
The New York Times reports California could face 50-foot waves as storms slam its coast. The swells are expected to reach the shoreline.
Trump told NBC News he wants to get Cuba done before 2029 and would consider military action. Several outlets reported his comments on the matter.
A Darth Vader lightsaber from the Star Wars films has sold for a record $4.87 million at auction. The sale comes as Star Wars marks 50 years with a new documentary.
The EU has agreed on five countries to represent Europe in Ukraine peace talks, while reports say the bloc still lacks a single voice. The move comes as European leaders push for a seat at the table.
The Tacony-Palmyra Bridge reopened hours after reports of a cargo ship strike. Traffic is moving across it again.
The Trump administration has delayed Medicaid work requirements by six months, according to NBC News. The change gives states and enrollees more time before the rules take effect.
Thunder and Clippers are the most-searched matchup in the US right now, with live updates and highlights for Friday's game. Tune in for the full story as it unfolds.
Nine.com.au reports Ukraine launched 1200 drones at Russia in a mass attack. The figure is the number the report leads with.
Nvidia announced a CEO transition after a week of turbulence, and searches for the chipmaker have spiked among US readers. Here is where the story stands.
Lauren Boebert, a Trump-backed Maga firebrand, lost her Colorado congressional race, according to The Guardian. The result closes a bruising stretch for the Republican firebrand.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says further American military action is not needed against Iran, pointing to the economic pain inflicted on the country. Iran has responded by warning of a decisive response to any renewed attacks.

Vivienne, Brad Pitt's daughter, revealed at a Los Angeles art exhibit that she was hospitalized for an eating disorder. She said the experience 'wasn't easy' and noted she had dropped her dad's last name.
Zelensky says the US has floated Ukraine giving up Donbas in exchange for Nato membership, according to the BBC. The report describes a proposal rather than an agreed deal.
Tennessee running back Daune Morris suffered a broken leg in a car accident, a major loss for the Volunteers before their game against Texas A&M. Fans are sending well wishes as the team adjusts.
Thousands of flights were canceled as airlines worked to recover from a nationwide ground stop. Travelers across the country are facing disrupted plans.
El Niño has arrived, and California's ocean temperatures are reportedly setting records. Here is what the shift could mean for where you live.

The head of the Gulf Cooperation Council told the UN that Iran has fired over 7,000 missiles and drones at Gulf nations since the war began. The figure is the GCC chief's own account, as reported in the headlines.
